__title: Squirio: Free Financial Tracker App for Android
__desc: Free financial tracker app for Android to manage budgets, expenses, savings, and cash flow. No account, cloud, ads, or tracking.
__ogalt: Squirio — your money stays on your phone. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
squirio_dashboard_showing_the: Squirio dashboard showing the pay period 25 July to 24 August, a balance of 4,182,500 rupiah, safe-to-spend per day, a spending heatmap for the period and recent transactions.
calendar_heatmap_of_daily: Calendar heatmap of daily spending across the pay period, darker squares meaning heavier days.
a_timeline_from_1: A timeline from 1 July to 31 August. The calendar month of August starts a week after the salary arrives on 25 July, splitting that paycheque from the spending it funds. A Squirio pay period instead runs from 25 July to 24 August, keeping them together.
squirio_insights_screen_showing: Squirio insights screen showing a financial health score of 78 out of 100, sub-scores for savings, budget and stability, and spending insight cards.
squirio_quick_add_sheet: Squirio quick add sheet: expense, income and transfer segments, favourite shortcuts for coffee, Grab and lunch, an expense amount of 1,250,000 rupiah, a date of 12 August 2026, the BCA account, a merchant field suggesting Ace Hardware, and a Save Transaction button.
squirio_amount_keypad_a: Squirio amount keypad: a full-height sheet showing the live expression 12,000 plus 3,500 in rupiah, a four by four key grid with a triple-zero key and divide, multiply, minus and plus, and a bottom row of backspace, clear, equals and Done.
squirio_budgets_screen_with: Squirio budgets screen with a donut showing the amount left this period and four budget bars, each with a pace marker.
donut_chart_of_spending: Donut chart of spending by category: Food and Dining 32 percent, Transport 21 percent, Shopping 16 percent, Bills 13 percent, Health 9 percent, Entertainment 6 percent, Other 3 percent.
calendar_heatmap_of_daily_2: Calendar heatmap of daily spending across the pay period, darker squares meaning heavier days.
the_budget_tracker_that: A free financial tracker that keeps your data on your phone.
squirio_is_a_personal: Squirio is an Android app for tracking expenses, budgets, savings, and debts. It requires no account, subscription, advertising, or paid tier. Your records stay in one file on your device, and budget periods can begin on payday instead of the first day of the month.
squi_intro: Squi marks empty states and completed goals.
squi_rule: Financial data screens do not use mascot illustrations.
tap_a_day_to: Tap a day to see its transactions
your_budget_resets_on: Budgets based on payday, not the 1st.
almost_every_finance_app: If you are paid on the 25th, a calendar-month report separates that income from much of the spending it covers. Squirio can use a period from the 25th to the 24th, keeping one salary and its expenses together.
the_paycheque_is_already: The August report starts a week after payday, so much of the income appears in the previous calendar month.
the_window_opens_the: The period begins on payday and ends the day before the next one, keeping the income and related spending together.
set_your_payday_once: Set the payday once during setup. The dashboard, budgets, reports, financial health score, and recap then use the same period.
pick_the_31st_and: If you choose the 31st, February uses its final calendar day.
periods_never_overlap_or: Periods never overlap or leave gaps.
each_one_ends_the: Each one ends the day before the next payday, whatever number you chose.
the_period_selector_sits: Use the period selector in the title area to open the previous cycle in one tap.
income_and_the_spending: Income and related spending use the same period
which_is_the_whole: , so the savings rate and financial health score use comparable data.
there_is_no_server: Local storage, with no Squirio account or server.
most_finance_apps_ask: Squirio stores financial records on your phone instead of creating a remote account. No outside copy is created unless you choose to export or back up the data.
everything_is_a_single: Squirio uses one SQLite database in the app's private storage. A remote copy is created only when you choose to share an export or backup.
one_tap_on_the: One tap on the eye icon masks every amount before you show the screen to someone else or use it in public.
leave_whenever_you_like: Export and back up your data
back_up_to_a: Export transactions to CSV or create a zip backup that you store yourself.
how_you_can_check: How to verify the offline design
no_tracking_is_easy: Turn on airplane mode and use the app. Entry, budgets, reports, insights, and warnings continue to work because they are processed on the phone. Squirio does not use internet access for these features. Data leaves the app only when you choose a destination from Android's share sheet.
it_notices_things_you: Financial insights calculated on your device.
squirio_reads_your_own: Squirio uses the transactions you record to show changes that may need attention.
when_the_same_merchant: When the same merchant charges a similar amount each month, Squirio can identify the pattern and offer to track it.
flags_an_unusual_amount: Flags an unusual amount as you type it.
if_a_coffee_costs: If a coffee entry is ten times your usual amount, Squirio shows the typical amount and asks you to confirm before saving. You can still save it.
scores_your_financial_health: Scores your financial health out of 100
from_your_savings_rate: from your savings rate, budget performance, and income stability. All three sub-scores remain visible.
names_your_fastest_growing: Shows the category with the largest increase
before_it_becomes_a: so you can review it before the cycle ends.
how_squirio_calculates_financial_health: How Squirio calculates its financial health score
health_score_method_intro: The financial health score summarizes patterns from the transactions you record within a pay cycle. Every calculation stays on your device, and all three sub-scores remain visible so the final number is not a hidden judgment.
savings_rate_method_body: Compares recorded income with spending in the same pay cycle. Transactions you have not recorded cannot be included.
budget_adherence_method_body: Compares spending with the budget limits you set and with how far the current pay cycle has progressed.
income_stability_method_body: Looks at changes in recorded income across completed pay cycles. Irregular income can make this value fluctuate more.
methodology_limits_heading: Limits and meaning of the score
methodology_limits_body: This score is an educational summary of the data you enter, not a credit score, a diagnosis of your financial condition, or financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. The completeness of your transactions and budgets determines the quality of the result. The final formula and its version number will be published with the release build so calculation changes remain traceable.
product_preview_heading: See Squirio's financial tracking in one screen
product_preview_body: This preview uses demonstration data and shows the pay cycle, balance, income, expenses, safe-to-spend guidance, wallets, and recent transactions.
product_preview_alt: Preview of the free Squirio financial tracker app showing a pay cycle, balance, income, expenses, safe-to-spend guidance, wallets, and recent transactions.
logging_a_transaction_takes: Log a transaction in three taps.
people_abandon_finance_trackers: Favorite transactions, merchant suggestions, and bulk editing reduce the work needed to keep records current.
a_keypad_built_for: A keypad built for six-digit numbers,
key_because_typing_1: key for entering large rupiah amounts quickly.
do_maths_in_the: Do maths in the amount field.
and_it_just_works: to calculate the result without opening another app.
start_typing_a_place: Start typing a saved merchant to reuse its account and category.
for_the_things_you: for frequent purchases. Duplicate and bulk-edit actions help when entering several older transactions.
85_used_means_nothing: Track budgets in the context of your pay cycle.
being_85_through_your: Using 85% of a food budget means something different on day 3 and day 27. Each budget shows a pace marker alongside the amount used.
switch_on_repeat_every: Turn on "Repeat every period" to reuse the limit in each cycle, including payday-based monthly periods. Turn it off for a one-time budget.
then_unspent_money_carries: Choose whether unused funds roll over.
pick_whether_a_quiet: Rollover can include only unused funds or also carry an overspent balance into the next period.
right_when_you_save: when a saved transaction crosses either threshold.
category_breakdowns_a_rolling: Review category totals, twelve-month cash flow, changes from your usual spending, daily spending intensity, and merchants with the highest totals.
every_day_of_the: Every day of the cycle, shaded by how much went out. Tap any square to see that day.
salary_rent_and_subscriptions: Salary, rent and subscriptions post themselves on schedule. Close the app for a month and everything catches up correctly when you open it.
set_a_target_put: Set an amount and deadline, record contributions, and see an estimated completion date based on your progress.
money_you_lent_and: Track money you lent and money you owe. The payoff calculator estimates the months needed for a chosen monthly payment.
cash_bank_credit_card: Track cash, bank, credit card, e-wallet, savings, and investment accounts, including transfers and net worth. Credit-card accounts show the outstanding balance.
bring_in_a_csv: Import a CSV from your bank or another app, map its columns, and review the preview before saving.
each_pay_cycle_gets: After a pay cycle ends, export its summary card as an image.
both_languages_fully_translated: The interface is available in English and Bahasa Indonesia. Rupiah amounts use no decimal places.
a_warm_palette_designed: A warm palette is used in both themes, with expenses shown in dusty rose instead of bright red.
balances_and_goal_progress: Balances and goal progress are calculated from transactions, so editing an older entry updates the affected results.
does_it_connect_to: Does it connect to my bank?
no_and_that_is: No. Enter transactions manually or import a CSV supplied by your bank. Squirio has no server or bank-aggregation service.
do_i_have_to: Do I have to set my budgets up again every month?
only_if_you_want: No. Turn on "Repeat every period" to renew a budget on each payday cycle. Leave it off for a one-time budget. Rollover is optional.
what_happens_if_i: What happens if I lose my phone?
phone_loss_answer: If the phone holds the only copy, the data is lost with it. Create a zip backup regularly and store it somewhere you control.
can_i_sync_between: Can I sync between two devices?
not_automatically_sync_means: Not automatically. Move data between devices with a backup file when needed.
which_platforms_will_it: Which platforms will it be on?
squirio_will_launch_exclusively: Squirio will launch exclusively on Android in October 2026.
pricing_isn_t_settled: Yes. Squirio is completely free, with no download fee, subscription, in-app purchase, advertising, or paid premium tier.
can_i_get_my: Can I get my data out?
any_time_two_ways: Yes. Create a full zip backup or export every transaction to CSV through Android's share sheet.
track_your_money_not: Track your money, not your worry.
coming_to_android_and: Free and coming exclusively to Android in October 2026.
footer_description: A completely free, private financial tracker for Android, built by Japandi Dev.
